curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42088-1-1.pdf (the cherry picker; the alternate model isn't in the book)

functions.does: The 12 tooth gear on the end of the long axle at the back of the boom's mount raises and lowers the boom: a worm on that axle turns the 24 tooth gear on the boom's pivot, and holds the boom wherever it's left.
functions.source: book: steps 30-31 (the worm on its axle, pages 28-29), 32 (the 24 tooth gear on the boom, pages 30-32); cover

functions.does: The boom's mount turns round on a single upright pin on the chassis, swinging the boom and bucket round.
functions.source: book: step 36 (page 38: the mount set onto the pin); inferred: that it turns, from how it sits on one pin

functions.does: The bucket turns round on the upright pins it hangs from at the boom's tip.
functions.source: book: page 37 (the bucket hung on a white connector between two blue pins)

functions.does: The bucket's hanger swings on a pin across the boom's tip, so the bucket hangs upright whatever the boom's angle.
functions.skip: only matters under gravity: the bucket's hanger is a free hinge

functions.does: The four wheels roll freely; there's no steering.
functions.source: inferred: each wheel turns on its own pin on the chassis

questions.question: Does the basket tilt, and is slewing a function?
